setup.title: Set up Lightning Pilot
setup.intro: Choose your password, verify an authenticator and save recovery codes before creating the owner.
setup.passwordRules: 12–128 characters, with lowercase, uppercase, a digit and a symbol.
setup.mismatch: The passwords are not the same.
setup.done: The owner is created. Log in with the new password.
setup.recoveryHint: Save these ten one-time codes. They are shown only once.
setup.recoveryCode: Type one recovery code you saved
setup.backupHint: Back up the vault key file separately from your database. The key itself is never displayed.
setup.backup: I have backed up the vault key file
setup.backupRequired: Confirm that you backed up the key file.
setup.nodeHint: Connect your Core Lightning node, or add one later. Use restricted view and optional spend runes.
setup.nodeInvalid: Check the node connection fields, or skip this step.
setup.limitsScope: Lightning Pilot spending limits — payments made by other apps are not limited.
setup.noLimit: Leave empty to explicitly choose no limit.
setup.limitsOrder: The step-up threshold must not exceed the per-payment limit, and the per-payment limit must not exceed the 24-hour limit.
setup.noFeeEstimate: This credential cannot read fee estimates. Enter a fee-rate cap yourself.
setup.alertsPending: Choose a destination or explicitly choose no alerts. Destinations are saved for later activation; alert delivery is still under development.
setup.chooseAlerts: Choose a destination or no alerts.
setup.nostrRelays: Nostr relays (wss URLs, separated by spaces)
setup.finishHint: Create the owner and save all verified choices together. You will be logged in.
setup.restartHint: The enrolment secret was shown once. Cancel and restart if you lost it.
setup.noAlertsWarning: Security alerts are not being sent anywhere. Delivery is still under development.
setup.feeStepUp: Allow the confirmed fee with password step-up
